principal_test: Widespread complete portal outage with no directly established technical cause; avoid fabricating a cause
Contained unavailability of a standard service with a workable manual alternative; avoid over-severity
Severe latency and intermittent timeouts while the service remains materially available
Contained throughput degradation with an effective workaround and an unconfirmed recent change
Direct client-side application exception affecting an optional feature with minimal current impact
Unhandled internal payment application exception occurring before healthy dependencies are called
Direct shared compute failure affecting multiple critical services and requiring coordination
Direct DNS or edge fault restricted to an internal test hostname with no demonstrated customer impact
Direct database-level connectivity or access configuration failure while the database platform remains available
Storage-access configuration failure affecting web assets; recommend investigation without changing permissions
Multiple services degraded with no established common cause or clear technical owner
User reports describe an outage after a deployment, but telemetry shows partial degradation and no confirmed causal relationship
